1. (Currently amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, __wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches__.

2. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced [[about]] __sixteen inches__ on center.

3. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced [[about]] __twenty-four inches__ on center.

4. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad.

5. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation.

6. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening.

7. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

8. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the water reservoir is filled with additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below a predetermined level.

9. (Original) The cooling system of claim 8, further including a ball float valve that opens to fill the water reservoir with the additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below the predetermined level.

10. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, further including a water drain.

11. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover.

12. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.

13. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall.

14. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the structure is a garage.

15. (Previously presented) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill.

16. (Original) The cooling system kit of claim 15, further including instructions.

17. (Currently amended) A cooling system, comprising: in a [[means for mounting within a structure wall, a means for evaporatively cooling an indoor area]] __housing configured for mounting within a structure wall, an evaporative cooling system for cooling an indoor area__.

18. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the [[means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling]] __housing is configured to place the evaporative cooling system__ between wall studs spaced [[about]] __sixteen inches__ on center.

19. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the [[means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling]] __housing is configured to place the evaporative cooling system__ within a structure wall, the structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF).

20. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the [[means for enclosing]] __housing__ protrudes from the wall less than three inches.
